question: Where were the Holy Relics of Lord Buddha enshrined during their visit to Vietnam as a part of the United Nations Day of Vesak celebrations in Vietnam.
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Thanh Tam Monastery.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Lord Buddha’s Holy Relics Arrive in Vietnam for Vesak Celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Holy Relics of Lord Buddha** arrived in **Ho Chi Minh City** with **Indian Union Minister Kiren Rijiju**, **Andhra Pradesh Minister Kandula Durgesh**, monks, and officials.

 
 
• 
 
The visit is part of the **United Nations Day of Vesak celebrations** in **Vietnam** from **May 6-8**.

 
 
• 
 
The Relics were received with **reverence** by **Vietnamese leaders** and **monks**.

 
 
• 
 
The Relics were **enshrined** at **Thanh Tam Monastery** after **ceremonial prayers**.

 
 
• 
 
A **Sacred Bodhi tree sapling** from India was planted at the **Vietnam Buddhist University**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Relics** were brought from **Sarnath**, supported by the **Mahabodhi Society**, **National Museum of India**, and **International Buddha Confederation**.

 
 
• 
 
The Relics will be displayed in **Ho Chi Minh City** until **May 7**, then travel to **Tay Ninh**, **Ha Noi**, and **Ha Nam** until **May 21**.
